normalisationRules: Contract override wins; otherwise Client applies.
A Contract cannot activate a capability unsupported by the Client or source format.
A hidden child setting is never effective.
Leaving split-rate mode stores a null current duration-break tie child.

contractResolution.qualification: For every current Candidate, Client, inclusive-work-date and source-route Contract, obtain exactly one fresh current result from the shared canonical Weekly one-shift calculation owner with source Actual hours and break, consume its same-final-rounding charge-pence sidecar, compare under NHSP_TWO_COMPONENT_PENCE_V1, and retain EXACT plus sign-consistent SOURCE_ROUNDING_EQUIVALENT without ranking. If exactly one Contract qualifies it is selected even when role or band text differs. Only when several qualify may a separately verified role/band mapping narrow the eligible shortlist; if that mapping would remove every otherwise eligible Contract, ignore it and keep the reliable shortlist. A full-negative row first reuses unique post-activation positive lineage. Without it, test only Candidate, actual Client, work-date and source-route Contracts against the signed negative result; select one automatically or ask Office only when several qualify. That choice prices the invoice reversal but never invents candidate-pay recovery lineage. Never substitute hours multiplied by one Contract rate, a source-derived hourly rate, a weekly/group total, a locked historical segment or a second bucket/rate/rounding calculation. Missing, duplicate, skipped, extra, locked-only or not-yet-parity-proved whole-shift output is UNVERIFIABLE. Generated historical reversals belong only to configured non-NHSP correction routes and do not participate in NHSP Contract qualification.
contractResolution.sourcePriceRule: Source money may qualify a Contract only through specifically approved versioned source-token and structural-comparison profiles. XLSX_BINARY64_SAME_VALUE_PENCE_V1 requires identical complete binary64 bits for one unique exact-penny candidate and is not an epsilon or decimal tolerance. Inferred hourly rates, display-value authority and direct browser comparison are forbidden.

xlsxBinary64SameValuePence.appliesOnlyTo: XLSX numeric OOXML tokens with non-zero digits beyond two decimal places
xlsxBinary64SameValuePence.algorithm: derive the adjacent exact signed-pence candidates with decimal-integer arithmetic; encode the raw token and each exact two-decimal candidate as IEEE-754 binary64; accept only when exactly one candidate has the identical complete 64-bit representation

penceAuthority.storage: signed database bigint for Commission, Total Cost, source sum, current calculated charge and signed difference
penceAuthority.arithmetic: signed integer addition and subtraction only

nhspPriceComparison.sourceCharge: every physical row: Commission and Total Cost are parsed from their authoritative coordinate-bound tokens to signed integer pence and added as signed integers; a positive row requires non-negative components and a positive sum, while a full-negative row requires non-positive components and a negative sum; mixed signs, lexical negative zero and an all-zero row are invalid

canonicalChargeOwner.sharedOwner: the same pure one-shift owner is called by compute-only comparison and the TSFIN writer
canonicalChargeOwner.comparisonInput: source Actual start, finish and break plus the exact current Contract, rates, policy, calendar and calculator fingerprints; source money is never an input
canonicalChargeOwner.comparisonOutput: exactly one identity-matched current segment and the internal charge-pence sidecar emitted by the owner's single existing final rounding operation
canonicalChargeOwner.wholeShiftAvailability: UNVERIFIABLE until the shared owner implements whole-shift mode and compute-only, TSFIN-write and rollback-contained golden masters prove identical final per-shift output

nhspPriceComparison.calculatedCharge: the fresh current identity-matched per-shift result from the shared canonical Weekly one-shift owner; consume only its same-final-rounding integer-pence sidecar and never reformat or reround charge_amount in the comparator
nhspPriceComparison.comparisonDomain: exact signed integer pence only; raw decimal equality, epsilon or threshold tolerance, independent binary-floating arithmetic, and browser-side arithmetic are forbidden

results.EXACT: the row has one approved sign shape and source charge minus fresh signed current calculated charge equals 0 pence: positive means non-negative components with a positive sum; full-negative means non-positive components with a negative sum
results.SOURCE_ROUNDING_EQUIVALENT: the row has one approved sign shape, source and calculated charge have the same non-zero sign, the exact recognised profile and current fingerprints agree, and the absolute signed-integer difference is exactly 1 pence in either direction
results.MISMATCH: both amounts, lineage where required and the applicable signed profile are valid but neither accepted result applies
results.UNVERIFIABLE: a component, coordinate-bound source token, sign rule, selected or prior-bound Contract, prior-positive lineage, rate, fresh current one-shift result, calculation parity, profile or fingerprint is missing, invalid, ambiguous, unsupported or stale; this includes all-zero or mixed-sign source rows, locked-historical-only calculation output and whole-shift mode before shared-owner parity

readyForFinalisation: MISMATCH or ZERO_SOURCE_CHARGE only with a current fingerprint-bound Office source-charge acceptance
nhspPriceComparison.readyForFinalisationAppliesTo: positive and valid full-negative NHSP physical rows after mapping and signed comparison gates; a first-activation full-negative row may invoice without candidate-pay recovery and displays Historical reversal—candidate pay not changed; generated historical reversals exist only for configured non-NHSP correction routes and require exact prior-snapshot binding and negation proof
blocksFinalisation: MISMATCH or ZERO_SOURCE_CHARGE until accepted on the current final backing report
nhspPriceComparison.finalReportChargeDecisionPresentation: An unaccepted eligible NHSP source-charge warning belongs in exactly one Blocked shift row, never Ready or a separate warning table. Show the number of issues and the highest-priority action; resolve mapping or structural blockers first. Expand that row to compare source Commission, Total Cost and sum with the selected Contract's fresh calculated charge and difference. Office may explicitly accept one, several or all eligible current shifts with an audited confirmation; the acceptance changes no source amount, candidate pay or invoice authority. Recheck all bindings under the atomic report finalisation lock. Checking imports cannot accept a final charge. Later corrected complete reports create physical correction movements instead of rewriting issued invoices. See WEEKLY_SOURCE_QUERY_FINALISATION_DECISIONS_20261002.md, 3 October successor amendment.
forbidden: generic tolerance beyond the named one-penny same-sign row rule
raw decimal or independent binary-floating equality
locked historical segment as current calculation
structurally invalid all-zero or mixed-sign row acceptance
negative-row Contract selection from source money
nhspPriceComparison.generatedHistoricalReversal: Configured non-NHSP correction routes only: not parsed as an NHSP source row; negate the complete prior frozen CloudTMS presentation exactly and check the positive replacement independently.
nhspPriceComparison.invoiceAmount: CloudTMS first calculates each physical shift from the selected Contract and current rate policy. Exact source Commission plus Total Cost pence is then permitted only when that calculation passes EXACT or the named same-sign one-penny row rule; that exact source pence becomes the invoice presentation so each row and the invoice total agree with the self-bill. Candidate pay always remains the CloudTMS pay result and never inherits the invoice penny adjustment. A configured non-NHSP generated historical reversal uses the exact negative of the prior frozen presentation.
nhspPriceComparison.isolation: source pence, calculated-comparison pence, difference, result, profile and reason remain in weekly-source audit/final-manifest/invoice-presentation data; none is written to or exposed through candidate pay, Timesheet financials, Workbench, Banking Pay or Case Resolution, and candidates and managers receive no money or pricing-unavailable detail
